A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Clear expectations.
From the start.

What should I include in my request?+

Your project location, the service you need, a short description, and your preferred timing. Documents can be discussed during follow-up.

Will my project need a site visit?+

A consultation or site visit may be recommended after reviewing your request. The appropriate next step depends on the project and scope.

How are scope and fees established?+

We discuss the requirements and outline the proposed services, deliverables, fees, and terms before work is authorized.

Does an inspection guarantee approval?+

No. Inspection acceptance and permit decisions remain with the authority having jurisdiction. Applicable authorizations and reporting requirements are reviewed for the project.
